## Objectives
- Understand the structure of balance of payments accounts.  
- Analyze capital flows and their regulation.   

## Key Concepts
- Current vs capital account.  
- Japan’s macroeconomic imbalances.  

## Readings (Suggested)
- IMF Balance of Payments Manual (selected sections).  
- Ito and Hoshi (2020), Chapter 12  

## Data
- [Bank of Japan — Foreign Direct Investment (Note)](https://www.boj.or.jp/en/statistics/br/bop_06/fdinote.htm)
- [IMF — Balance of Payments Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6)](https://www.imf.org/external/pubs/ft/bop/2007/bopman6.htm)
- [IMF DataMapper — Current Account Balance (% of GDP)](https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/BCA_NGDPD@WEO/OEMDC/ADVEC/WEOWORLD)
